svg.title: Single Bierdeckel guide
svg.desc: Extracted from rect6 in axidraw-template-bierdeckel.svg supplied by the project owner. Original guide centerline: 92.739998 mm square, 10 mm corner radii, x/y 0.2 mm, 0.4 mm stroke. Rounded to 92.74 mm. Canvas includes the guide stroke. Preview reference only; excluded from protein SVG exports.
